# These files are NOT scanned by TruffleHog for secrets
# Patterns: RE2 regular expressions matched against file paths
# (TruffleHog cannot compile glob syntax such as *.md)

# Documentation
^docs/
\.md$
^LICENSE$

# Example files (intentionally have placeholder secrets)
^\.env\.example$
/\.env\.example$

# Test fixtures
/test/fixtures/
/__tests__/fixtures/

# Build artifacts
^node_modules/
^dist/
^build/
^\.next/
^\.nuxt/

# Lock files (can contain hashes that look like secrets)
^package-lock\.json$
^yarn\.lock$
^pnpm-lock\.yaml$

# Helm chart values (have placeholder passwords)
^k8s/examples/
/values\.yaml$
